##2.seurat obj
```{r}
# ── 2. Collect into a list ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
data_list <- list(m1, m2, m3, m4, m5, m6, m7, m8, m9)

# ── 3. Processing function ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
process_matrix <- function(mat, sample_name, expected_cells = 5000) {
  
  # Handle multimodal data (e.g., GEX + ADT); keep Gene Expression only
  if (is.list(mat)) mat <- mat[["Gene Expression"]]
  
  # Identify real cells using defaultDrops
  em   <- defaultDrops(mat, expected = expected_cells)
  keep <- which(em)
  
  # Safety check
  if (length(keep) == 0)
    stop(paste("No cells retained for sample:", sample_name))
  
  # Subset to real cells
  mat_filtered <- mat[, keep, drop = FALSE]
  
  # Create Seurat object
  Obj <- CreateSeuratObject(
    counts       = mat_filtered,
    project      = "Lymph Nodes",
    min.cells    = 3,
    min.features = 200
  )
  
  # Track sample origin
  Obj$sample <- sample_name
  
  return(Obj)
}

# ── 4. Define per-sample expected cell counts ─────────────────────────────────
expected_cells_vec <- c(5000, 5000, 5000, 5000, 5000, 5000, 5000, 5000, 5000)
# Adjust each value above based on your actual sample expectations

# ── 5. Process all samples ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
obj_list <- lapply(
  seq_along(data_list),
  function(i) process_matrix(data_list[[i]],
                              sample_name    = paste0("Obj", i),
                              expected_cells = expected_cells_vec[i])
)
names(obj_list) <- paste0("Obj", seq_along(obj_list))

# ── 6. Merge all Seurat objects ───────────────────────────────────────────────
Obj <- merge(
  x            = obj_list[[1]],
  y            = obj_list[2:length(obj_list)],
  add.cell.ids = names(obj_list),        # now consistent: "Obj1","Obj2",...
  project      = "LymphNodes"
)
saveRDS(Obj,file = "data/process/SeuratObjects/Lymph_data/LN_raw.rds")

```

##5integration
```{r}


##integration
library(harmony)
Obj =RunHarmony(Obj,group.by.vars = "sample",orig.reduction = "pca",dims.use = 1:30  )
Obj[["RNA"]]=JoinLayers(Obj[["RNA"]])
Obj = RunUMAP(Obj, reduction = "harmony", dims= 1:30, reduction.name = "umap.harmony")
DimPlot(Obj,reduction = "umap.harmony",group.by = c("sample"),label.size = 2, shuffle = T)


#for the resolution
Obj=FindNeighbors(Obj,dims = 1:30)
for (res in seq(0.2, 1, by = 0.1)) {
  Obj <- FindClusters(Obj, resolution = res)
  colname <- paste0("res_", res)
  Obj[[colname]] <- Obj$seurat_clusters
}
res_cols <- grep("^res_", colnames(Obj@meta.data), value = TRUE)
for (res in res_cols) {
  p <- DimPlot(Obj, group.by = res, label = TRUE, reduction = "umap.harmony") +
       ggtitle(paste("Resolution:", res))
  print(p)
  readline(prompt="Press [Enter] to see the next resolution...")
}

#save 
p_res04=DimPlot(Obj,group.by = "res_0.4",label = TRUE,reduction = "umap.harmony" ) + ggtitle("Resolution: 0.4") +
  labs(x = "UMAP.h", 
        y = "UMAP.h")
ggsave(filename = "output/Lymph_node/resolution.pdf",plot = p_res04,width = 10,height = 8,dpi = 300)
```

###5-clusters and find all markers
```{r}
###clusters

Obj=FindNeighbors(Obj,reduction = "harmony",dims = 1:30)
Obj=FindClusters(Obj, resolution = 0.4,cluster.name = "harmony_clusters")
#markers
Obj_markers=FindAllMarkers(Obj,only.pos = TRUE,min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = 0.25)
Obj_markers = Obj_markers%>% filter(p_val_adj < 0.05, abs(avg_log2FC) > 0.25)



```



###6. annotation
```{r}


library(dplyr)
library(openxlsx)

# Get all clusters
clusters <- unique(Obj_markers$cluster)

# List to store top 30 genes per cluster
top_genes_list <- list()

# Loop over clusters
for(clust in clusters){
  top_genes <- Obj_markers %>%
    filter(cluster == clust) %>%
    arrange(desc(avg_log2FC)) %>%   # sort by log fold-change
    slice_head(n = 30) %>%          # take top 30
    pull(gene)                      # get gene names
  
  top_genes_list[[paste0("cluster_", clust)]] <- top_genes
}

# Print top 30 per cluster
for(clust in names(top_genes_list)){
  cat("=== ", clust, " ===\n")
  print(top_genes_list[[clust]])
  cat("\n")
}

# Combine into a table for Excel
top_genes_df <- data.frame(
  matrix(
    NA,
    nrow = 30,
    ncol = length(clusters),
    dimnames = list(NULL, paste0("cluster_", clusters))
  )
)

for(i in seq_along(clusters)){
  clust <- clusters[i]
  genes <- top_genes_list[[paste0("cluster_", clust)]]
  top_genes_df[1:length(genes), i] <- genes
}




```

```{r}

#####for markers
# Identity

Idents(Obj) <- "General"


Obj$General <- gsub("-", "_", Obj$General)
Idents(Obj) <- "General"


# Expression matrix

DefaultAssay(Obj) <- "RNA"
expr_mat <- GetAssayData(Obj, layer = "data")


# genes in list

genes <- genes[genes %in% rownames(expr_mat)]
if (length(genes) < 2) stop("Too few genes found")


# Cell

celltypes <- levels(factor(Idents(Obj)))


# Percent expression

percent_mat <- sapply(celltypes, function(ct) {
  cells <- WhichCells(Obj, idents = ct)
  Matrix::rowMeans(expr_mat[genes, cells, drop = FALSE] > 0) * 100
})
percent_mat <- as.matrix(percent_mat)


# Average expression

avg_exp <- AverageExpression(
  Obj,
  features = genes,
  assays = "RNA",
  layer = "data",
  return.seurat = FALSE
)$RNA


colnames(avg_exp) <- gsub("-", "_", colnames(avg_exp))


# Align
common_ct <- intersect(celltypes, colnames(avg_exp))
if (length(common_ct) < 2) stop("Cell type mismatch still exists")

percent_mat <- percent_mat[, common_ct, drop = FALSE]
exp_mat <- as.matrix(avg_exp[genes, common_ct, drop = FALSE])


#Clean

exp_mat[is.infinite(exp_mat)] <- NA
exp_mat <- exp_mat[rowSums(is.na(exp_mat)) < ncol(exp_mat), , drop = FALSE]
percent_mat <- percent_mat[rownames(exp_mat), , drop = FALSE]

exp_mat[is.na(exp_mat)] <- 0
mode(exp_mat) <- "numeric"


# Scaling

exp_mat_scaled <- log1p(exp_mat)

if (all(exp_mat_scaled == 0)) stop("No expression signal")

exp_mat_scaled <- t(scale(t(exp_mat_scaled)))
exp_mat_scaled[is.na(exp_mat_scaled)] <- 0


# Color

q <- quantile(exp_mat_scaled, c(0.05, 0.5, 0.95), na.rm = TRUE)
q <- unique(as.numeric(q))
q <- q[is.finite(q)]

if (length(q) < 2) q <- range(exp_mat_scaled, na.rm = TRUE)
col_fun <- circlize::colorRamp2(q, c("navy", "white", "firebrick"))


# dot
cell_fun <- function(j, i, x, y, w, h, fill) {
  grid::grid.circle(
    x = x, y = y,
    r = (percent_mat[i, j] / 100) * 0.45 * min(grid::unit.c(w, h)),
    gp = grid::gpar(fill = col_fun(exp_mat_scaled[i, j]), col = "black")
  )
}


# Cell colors

cols <- grDevices::colorRampPalette(
  RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(8, "Set2")
)(length(common_ct))

names(cols) <- common_ct

column_ha <- ComplexHeatmap::HeatmapAnnotation(
  celltype = common_ct,
  col = list(celltype = cols),
  show_annotation_name = FALSE
)


# plot
ht <- ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(
  exp_mat_scaled,
  name = "Expression",
  col = col_fun,
  rect_gp = grid::gpar(type = "none"),
  cell_fun = cell_fun,
  row_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 7, fontface = "bold"),
  column_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 10, fontface = "bold"),
  column_names_rot = 90,
  border = TRUE,
  top_annotation = column_ha,
  row_km = 4
)


# save
pdf("output/Lymph_node/heatmap.pdf",
    width = 12, height = 12)

ComplexHeatmap::draw(ht)
dev.off()


```

##2QC

```{r}



#check the threshold before
hist(
  colSums(counts(sce) > 0),
  breaks = 100,
  main = "Detected genes per cell",
  xlab = "Number of genes"
)

# basic filters
sce <- scater::addPerCellQC(sce)
min.features <- 500
min.cells <- 5

qc <- scater::perCellQCMetrics(sce)
sce <- sce[rowSums(counts(sce) >= 1) >= min.cells, ]
sce <- sce[, colSums(counts(sce) >= 1) >= min.features]


#mt
is.mito <- grep("MT-", rownames(sce))
per.cell <- scuttle::perCellQCMetrics(sce, subsets=list(Mito=is.mito))
colData(sce)[['subsets_Mito_percent']] <- per.cell$subsets_Mito_percent

class(colData(sce)$subsets_Mito_percent)
hist(
  colData(sce)$subsets_Mito_percent,
  breaks = 100,
  main = "Mitochondrial percentage per cell",
  xlab = "Percent mitochondrial reads"
)
sce <- sce[, colData(sce)$subsets_Mito_percent < 15]
#rm(RA)
```

```{r}
assay(sce, 'logcounts') <- scuttle::normalizeCounts(sce, size.factors=lib.sizes, log=FALSE, center.size.factors=FALSE)

head(colData(sce))
```

```{r}
#-----run liliana
liana_res <- liana_bysample( sce = sce,
                      sample_col = "sample", # context dimension column from SCE metadata
                      idents_col = "General", # cell types column from SCE metadata
                      resource = 'Consensus',
                      expr_prop = 0.1, # must be expressed in expr_prop fraction of cells
                      min_cells = 5,
                      assay.type = 'logcounts', # run on log- and library-normalized counts
                      aggregate_how = 'both', # aggregate magnitude and specificity
                      verbose = TRUE,
                      inplace = FALSE, #save it out of the sce obj
                      permutation.params=list(nperms=100),
                      return_all=TRUE
                      )
#we convert to data frame 

names(liana_res) <- unique(colData(sce)$sample) #all sample name 
library(dplyr)
liana_res <-bind_rows(liana_res, .id = "sample")
liana_res$sample <- as.character(liana_res$sample)
table(liana_res$sample)
write.csv(liana_res, file = "CCC/Lymph_node/liana_res.csv", row.names = FALSE)


# Filter strong interactions

liana_filt <- liana_res %>%
  filter(magnitude_rank <= 0.05,
         cellphonedb.pvalue <= 0.01)
  table(liana_filt$sample)   
  write.csv(liana_filt, file = "CCC/Lymph_node/liana_filt.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
